title: Customer Engineer
description:
**Customer Engineer — Rocketlane**


**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing SaaS company redefining how professional services teams


deliver customer projects. We recently raised $60M in Series C led by Insight Partners,


bringing total funding to over $105M from investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and


Nexus Venture Partners. With Nitro, our agentic execution platform, we've built an


AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and


surfaces delivery risks, right inside customer project workflows. We're 200\+ people building a


product that services teams love, and we're just getting started.


**What will you do?**


As a Customer Engineer, you'll be the hands\-on technical engine behind how our customers


connect Rocketlane to the rest of their tech stack. Working alongside FDEs, implementation


teams, and Product Managers, you'll spend your time understanding a customer's tools,


platforms, and data, and then building the pipelines and integrations that make everything


talk to each other.


This is a Customer Engineering role where you won't be expected to run enterprise accounts


solo on day one. Instead, you'll join client calls, learn to read a customer's technology


ecosystem quickly, and take ownership of well\-scoped engineering work: data models,


integrations, scripts, and connectors. Over time, as your judgment and customer instincts


grow, you'll take on bigger pieces of the deployment and start feeding what you learn in the


field back into the product.


**You don't need prior work experience to be great at this role.** If your final\-year project, a


hackathon build, or a personal side project involved wiring systems together, wrangling


messy data, or building something people actually used — that's exactly the muscle this role


needs. If you love writing code and being close to the customer, and "pure backend


engineer" feels too far from the people using what you build, this role is for you.**What you'll be responsible for**


**Data engineering across the customer's stack**


Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations that connect Rocketlane with the


tools our customers already use (CRM, HRMS, ERP, finance tools, data warehouses,


internal APIs).


Model and shape messy, real\-world customer data so it's clean and usable in


production.


Write Python scripts and small utilities to move, transform, and validate data between


systems.


**Understanding the customer's technology ecosystem**


Learn how each customer's platforms, tools, and data fit together, and translate that


into a clear picture the team can build against.


Join technical discovery and working sessions with senior FDEs — listening, asking


sharp questions, and gradually taking on more of the conversation.


**Hands\-on engineering with AI**


Work with LLMs to build customer\-specific automations: from simple prompt\-driven


scripts to connecting Nitro agents to customer data.


Debug integration and data issues, do root\-cause analysis, and ship fixes quickly —


with support from senior team members while you're ramping up.


**Contributing back to the product**


Surface recurring customer patterns, edge cases, and gaps to Product and


Engineering.


Help build reusable templates, connectors, and internal tooling so each deployment


makes the next one faster.


**Must\-have skills**


**0–3 years of software development experience, or strong, demonstrable**


**project experience** (final\-year projects, internships, hackathons, or open\-source


work) — comfortable writing clean Python.


Solid grasp of **data structures, data modeling, and databases** — coursework or


project\-level SQL and an understanding of how data flows between systems is


enough.


Comfortable reading and working with **REST APIs**: testing endpoints, understanding


auth, and wiring up integrations — even if this was only done in a class project or


personal build.


Some hands\-on exposure to **LLMs**: prompting, calling model APIs, or building small


AI\-powered tools — a weekend project counts.


Genuine interest in the customer side: the confidence to be on client calls, ask good


questions, and explain technical things clearly — think: explaining your project to a


professor outside your specialization, or to judges at a hackathon.


A bias toward action — your project history should show you dug into problems on


your own rather than only completing assigned coursework.


**Good\-to\-have skills**


Experience with ETL / data pipeline tools or integration platforms (Make, Workato,


Boomi, or similar) — academic or self\-taught exposure counts.


Familiarity with AI\-assisted dev tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, etc.).


Exposure to cloud (AWS/GCP), Postman, Docker, or webhooks — free\-tier or


personal\-project experience is fine.


Any internship, coursework, or project experience in a customer\-facing or B2B SaaS


setting.


A GitHub, portfolio, or demo link for your best project — we'd genuinely like to see


what you've built.


**You should apply if you**


Want to build real things that go live in customer environments in weeks, not


quarters.


Enjoy the mix of writing code and being in the room with customers.


Are early in your career — including brand new to the workforce — but hungry to


grow fast into a full Forward Deployed / Customer Engineer.


**Why join us?**


**Impact and ownership from day one** — small team, real problems, your work in


production.


**Learn from the best** — you'll be mentored by senior FDEs and see how enterprise


deployments actually work.


**Front\-row seat to the AI era** — build with frontier models and deploy real agents


into real businesses.


**Best\-in\-class benefits** — comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and


support for you and your family.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
#### **About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.


Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.


We’re a close\-knit team of over 200 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fuelled by $105M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.
  

  

**Profile Overview**  

  

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own the systems and data infrastructure that power Rocketlane's go\-to\-market engine. This role sits at the center of our sales and pipe gen tech stack \- CRM, outbound tooling, inbound routers, PRM, and the integrations that connect them. You'll be the person who makes sure data flows cleanly across systems, the right accounts get in front of the right reps, and decisions like territory planning and account scoring are backed by a clean, well\-structured data model. You'll work closely with Revenue, and Pipe Gen leaders. Your mission: keep the GTM tech stack running as one coherent system instead of a pile of disconnected tools, and make sure territory planning, routing, and account scoring sit on solid foundations. Expect high ownership, deep systems/API work, and close partnership with pipe gen leaders on experiments.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


* Own the CRM end\-to\-end: data model, structure, hygiene, and scalability as the sales org grows
* Own the broader sales/pipe gen tech stack: outbound tech stack, inbound routers, PRM, and related systems
* Build seamless integrations across systems: data sync, alerts, and workflows that just work
* Own territory planning: the single most important strategic initiative for a fast\-growing sales org
* Codify our ICP into account scoring and prioritization models
* Build and maintain lists for outbound and experiments using modern GTM tooling (Clay, Bitscale, etc.)
* Be a thought partner to pipe gen leaders: help design and run experiments, and support on the GTM engineering side
* Provide general support to sales and pipe gen teams (lowest priority \- this is a builder seat, not a ticket queue)

  

**What We're Looking For**


* 2 to 6 years of experience in RevOps, sales ops, or marketing ops (not an LDR/SDR or MRE\-to\-ops path)
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot/Salesforce: comfortable inside the CRM's data model, not just its UI
* Experience building lists with modern GTM tooling (Clay, Bitscale, or similar)
* Solid understanding of integrations, APIs, and tokens: you're comfortable wiring systems together, not just using them
* Data and BI tools experience is a plus
* Strong process thinker with an eye for efficiency, and a builder mindset
* Good with numbers, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail \- you spot trends, catch errors, and back decisions with data
* Clear communicator who can bridge business needs and system design
* High ownership operator who thrives in fast\-paced environments
* Curious about the latest in GTM tooling, especially AI and automation across the sales/pipeline stack

#### **Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company redefining how professional services teams deliver customer projects. We recently raised **$60M in Series C funding led by Insight Partners**, bringing our total funding to over $105M from top investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, along with super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg.


Our mission? To move the professional services industry from tracking work to *executing it*. With **Nitro**, our agentic execution platform, we've built the industry's first AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and surfaces delivery risks \- directly inside customer project workflows. We're a team of 200\+ passionate folks building a product that services teams love, and we're just getting started on the Outcome Era.


**What will you do? (Role Overview)**
-------------------------------------


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** on Rocketlane's AI Implementation team, you will own the technical success of our strategic customers as they adopt **Nitro AI agents**. You'll embed with customer teams \- running discovery, designing agent workflows, configuring integrations, engineering prompts, and shipping production\-grade apps and agents that drive measurable outcomes.


This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll understand customer workflows, orchestrate agents, write code debug live issues, and translate what you learn in the field into product improvements that shape the future of Nitro. If "professional services consultant" feels too removed from the keyboard and "pure product engineer" feels too removed from the customer, this role is built for you.


You'll be a founding member of our AI\-first Professional Services org \- someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving puzzles, and is energized by seeing their work live in production within weeks, not quarters.


**What You'll Be Responsible For**
----------------------------------


### **Customer\-Embedded Agent Deployment**


* Own end\-to\-end deployment of Nitro AI agents for enterprise customers \- from discovery and solution design to configuration, go\-live, and ongoing optimization.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders (Services leaders, IT, Operations, Revenue teams) to map business workflows to Nitro agent capabilities.
* Design agent architectures that solve real delivery problems: migration agents, workforce agents, documentation agents and custom workflows tailored to each customer's environment.
* Build and deploy custom integrations between Nitro and customer systems (CRM, HRMS, ERP, Finance tools, data warehouses, internal APIs).

### **Hands\-On Engineering**


* Write production\-grade code/ scripts to extend, customize, or integrate Nitro agents into customer workflows.
* Engineer prompts, design evaluation frameworks, and tune agent behavior for customer\-specific data, terminology, and edge cases.
* Build data pipelines and connectors to feed agents with the right context \- SOWs, project history, customer communications, and structured delivery data.
* Debug live agent behavior in customer environments, perform root\-cause analysis on complex system interactions, and ship fixes fast.

### **Trusted Technical Advisor**


* Serve as the technical point of contact for strategic accounts throughout their Nitro implementation journey.
* Guide customers toward best\-practice implementations \- and push back when needed. Your job is to advise, not just execute requirements.
* Translate customer pain into clear problem statements, then into shipped solutions. Our model is simple: spend time understanding customer workflows, then build agents.

### **Product Feedback Loop**


* Be the voice of the customer inside Rocketlane. Surface patterns, edge cases, and feature gaps to our Product and Engineering teams.
* Prototype and validate new agent capabilities in the field before they become full product investments.
* Contribute to internal playbooks, reusable agent templates, and scaled enablement content so every FDE engagement makes the next one faster.

### **Pre\-Sales \& POC Support**


* Partner with Sales and Solutions teams on high\-stakes enterprise deals \- building rapid POCs, running technical validations, and proving the business case for Nitro.
* Represent Rocketlane's technical depth in customer executive conversations, demos, and architecture reviews.

**Must\-Have Skills**
---------------------


### **Engineering \& Technical Depth**


* **3–5 years of hands\-on software engineering/product management experience**, with the ability to write production\-grade code in at least one of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
* Strong command of **REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/auth flows, and enterprise integration patterns** \- you can read API docs, test endpoints, and ship integrations without hand\-holding.
* Good understanding of **data modeling and ETL** \- comfortable working with messy enterprise data and shaping it for production use.
* Comfortable with modern cloud, DevOps, and integration tooling (Postman, AWS/GCP, Docker, iPaaS platforms like Workato/Boomi/Make).

### **AI \& Agent Engineering**


* **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and AI agent frameworks** \- prompt engineering, agent orchestration and evaluation/guardrails.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, or similar) to move faster and build utilities that make deployments scalable.
* Strong intuition for when to use an agent vs. deterministic automation, and how to design human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that customers trust.

### **Customer\-Facing Instincts**


* 1\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role \- Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or similar at a B2B SaaS or AI company.
* Proven ability to drive enterprise deployments end\-to\-end with minimal supervision, including discovery, solutioning, and leading technical conversations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication \- you can sit in a room with a VP of Services and earn their trust, then turn around and write clean technical documentation.
* Ability to simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders

### **Problem\-Solving \& Ownership**


* **Bias toward action and ownership.** You see a problem, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket.
* Strong first\-principles thinking \- you can decompose a messy customer problem into a solvable, shippable plan.
* Thrives in ambiguity. Comfortable operating without a playbook, because you're often the one writing it.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
-------------------------


* Experience with **Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools** \- Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA, Kantata, etc.
* Background in **Professional Services, Customer Success Engineering, or technical implementation** at enterprise SaaS companies.
* Prior exposure to building or deploying **agentic AI systems** in production at an AI\-native or AI\-forward company.

**You Should Apply If You:**
----------------------------


* Want to be at the frontline of deploying real, production AI agents that change how businesses operate \- not just build another chatbot.
* Love owning customer outcomes end\-to\-end and thrive on the blend of engineering and customer conversations.
* Get energized by solving puzzles in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being written.
* Are driven by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales \- and want to help define what "Forward Deployed Engineer" means at Rocketlane.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


At Rocketlane, we're all about building a great product *and* a great place to work. Here's why you'll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership:** You won't just be another cog in the machine; here, you're more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best:** We're a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins:** Whether we're hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow:** We're all about learning \- and not just the latest SaaS trends. You'll grow your career, pick up new skills, and work on problems that most engineers only read about.
* **Front\-row seat to the AI era:** You'll build with frontier models, deploy real agents into real enterprises, and see your work drive measurable business outcomes in weeks.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits:** Comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and benefits designed to support you and your family.

title: CloudOps Engineer III
description:

This is a senior operational role for someone who can take ownership of complex, high\-impact environments, work confidently and independently, and act as a clear communication point between customers, Professional Services, and the wider CloudOps team.

You'll combine hands\-on technical delivery with strong stakeholder communication — leading incident response and change activity, running and contributing to governance and status meetings, and keeping the team informed and aligned. You'll be trusted to use your own judgement and initiative to drive issues to resolution, backed by the support and expertise of an experienced team.
### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support enterprise customers' cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring availability, performance, and security of production environments.
* Monitor and respond to alerts via observability tooling, triaging and resolving incidents in line with agreed SLAs and SLOs.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex or high\-severity issues, producing clear write\-ups and remediation actions.
* Carry out change management activities — including deployments, security patching, and infrastructure updates following established change control and CR governance processes.
* Administer and optimise AWS database infrastructure (e.g. RDS), including performance tuning, troubleshooting, and exposure/risk remediation.
* Support compliance and audit activity (e.g. SOC audits), ensuring operational practices meet security and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and help deliver cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
* Maintain accurate tickets, documentation, and workaround registers, and help close down accumulated technical debt.

### **Communication \& stakeholder management:**

**Responsibilities \& Requirements**
  

**1\. Enterprise Database Architecture \& Technical Strategy**
  

Architect, design, and deliver end\-to\-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis).
  

Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high\-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments.

Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling.
  

Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re\-platform and refactor applications for cloud\-native persistence layers.
  

**3\. High Availability, Replication \& Scalability Engineering**
  

Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets \& Sharded Clusters).
  

Establish cross\-region and multi\-data\-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission\-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
